summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Display & Cell Pros 3D repair site. 6/6 pytest backend tests pass (health, services, products, quote engine with expected 387.0 flagship-screen professional subtotal, booking create+persist). Frontend Playwright: hero 3D canvas mounts, Quote Lab produces correct live pricing ($387 professional), Store cart increments on add-to-cart, Booking form submits and shows success with ticket ID, nav smooth-scroll works.

issues: Harmless WebGL 'GPU stall due to ReadPixels' performance warnings — cosmetic, does not affect functionality

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: QuoteRequest lacks enum validation on issueType/deviceTier; unknown issueType falls through to 'other' returning parts=30 silently. Consider Pydantic Literal or validators to return 400 on invalid input.
server.py: parts_cost for issue_type=='battery'/'port' uses dict[quality] which will KeyError (500) for invalid quality — currently safe because quality is server-controlled, but brittle.
QuoteLab.js/Booking.js/Store.js: axios errors are swallowed silently (/* noop */). No user-facing error state — add error toast/UI when API fails.
Booking.js: no client-side validation feedback for empty required fields (silent return on submit).
server.py: CORS allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True is a common misconfiguration (browsers will reject credentialed requests). Fine here since no auth, but flag for future.
server.py: single-file backend is small (~170 lines) — acceptable, no split needed.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_ prefixed booking inserted into MongoDB via test_create_and_list_booking
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all 5 endpoints. All flows green end-to-end.
